question: Are Pfizer's 92 D02 excerpts the 92 that should be taken? A frozen Run, an Evidence PASS and a published row answer whether the machinery worked, not whether the content is right.

method.what_was_done: every block inside the four declared scope ranges was printed with its index, its emphasis and link flags, its length, its text and whether the selector took it. Each was then judged by reading, against the approved source definition - entity_scope registrant, source 'Item 3 / legal proceedings / contingencies notes'.
method.what_was_not_done: the expected answer was not generated by the selector, by a second copy of it, or by any keyword list. That would have produced agreement rather than a check.

where_the_92_come_from.note: NOTE_16_SUB_A is nested inside ITEM_8, so the two are not additive. ITEM_3's single block is the 77-character hyperlink already registered as a separate defect.

the_auditor_s_voice.what_they_are: the independent registered public accounting firm's critical audit matter, 'Evaluation of product liability and other product-related litigation'. Block 1884 begins 'The following are the primary procedures we performed' - 'we' is the auditor.
the_auditor_s_voice.why_out: the Spec's entity_scope is registrant and the approved source is Item 3, the legal proceedings section and the contingencies notes. The auditor's report is none of those, and a set that mixes the two voices cannot be read as the registrant's disclosure.

single_keyword_admissions.2240: trade accounts receivable credit-loss policy. It matched on 'written off after all reasonable means to collect the full amount (including litigation, where appropriate) have been exhausted' - the word describes debt collection.
single_keyword_admissions.2175: critical accounting estimates. It matched on 'litigation' inside a list: 'changes in the healthcare environment, competition, litigation, legislation, development of competing assets'.
single_keyword_admissions.why_out: neither is a legal-proceedings or contingencies disclosure. This is the _LEGAL keyword limitation the register already names, now with two measured instances rather than a general warning.

in_scope_missed.consequence: blocks 3859-3864 lose their Comirnaty heading, 3871-3872 lose Paxlovid, 3883-3885 lose Asbestos, 3887-3888 lose Docetaxel, 3890-3891 and 3897-3898 lose Zantac, 3900 loses Chantix. The paragraphs are all present; what is gone is the label saying which matter each is about.
in_scope_missed.the_inconsistency_that_makes_it_visible: Orgovyx (relugolix), Eliquis (apixaban), Oxbryta (voxelotor), Nurtec (rimegepant) and Xtandi (enzalutamide) are all kept. The difference is that their generic name in parentheses pushes them over twelve characters. Whether a product heading survives depends on how long its generic name is, which is not a rule anyone would write down.

what_is_correct: every substantive paragraph of Note 16A is present and in document order
the scope boundary [3821, 3937) is right: B guarantees, C commitments, D contingent consideration and E insurance all begin at or after 3937 and none appears in the set

the 25 running-header blocks - 'Pfizer Inc.', '2025 Form 10-K', the page number, 'Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements', 'Pfizer Inc. and Subsidiary Companies', repeated five times - are all correctly excluded
the two in-scope items outside the sub-note, 2302 (the contingencies note lead-in) and 2351 (the Seagen legal matters bullet), are correctly included
what_this_changes_now: the coordinate is registered as defective and withdrawn from current delivery. business_content_accepted was already false everywhere; this replaces 'not checked' with 'checked and wrong in six places and short in seven'.
what_this_does_not_do: change the approved definition - each item was judged against it, not against a new one
repair the selector, which is a separate change with its own measurements
say anything about the other eight companies' D02 sets, which have not been read

rules._page_furniture: a repeated block is furniture only when the block before or after it also repeats - furniture travels in company
rules._note_heading: inside a located note scope, an emphasized unlinked block carrying a letter is content even under twelve characters

out_of_scope_still_taken.why_not_yet: the cause is that ITEM_8 is scanned as a proxy for the contingencies notes the definition names. Narrowing it changes every filing's set and one filing has been read. Inventing a rule for where the auditor's report ends from a single example is the mistake this whole exercise exists to avoid.
